record.field: ${object.partner_id and object.partner_id.email and object.partner_id.id or False }

field.name: body_html
field.div: % set partner = object.partner_id % set plural = partner.title.plural or partner.title.id == 29 % set sponsorships = object.get_objects() % set children = sponsorships.mapped('child_id') % set firstname = children.get_list('preferred_name', 3, children.get_number(), translate=False) % set less_3 = firstname != children.get_number() % set nb_years = (sponsorships[:1].contract_duration // 364) % set is = 'are' if children|length > 1 else 'is'
field.p: % if nb_years > 0: After ${(datetime.datetime.now() - sponsorships[:1].start_date).days // 364} years of support from you and the staff in the field, ${firstname} ${is} coming to the end of the sponsorship journey in the next few weeks. % else: ${firstname} ${is} coming to the end of the sponsorship journey in the next few weeks. % endif
That's a reason to celebrate and be thankful!
We will send you more detailed information about the end of the sponsorship by mail in the coming days.
Thank you so much for your investment in the life of ${firstname}.

record.field: ${object.partner_id and object.partner_id.email and object.partner_id.id or False }

field.name: body_html
field.div: % set sponsorships = object.get_objects() % set child = sponsorships.mapped('child_id') % set one = len(child) == 1 % set name = child.get_list('preferred_name', 3, 'your children') % if one: % set lifecycle = child.mapped('lifecycle_ids') and child.mapped('lifecycle_ids')[0] % endif % set sub = sponsorships.mapped('sub_sponsorship_id.child_id')
field.p:
${object.partner_id.salutation},
We would like to sincerely thank you for investing in the life of ${name}, ${child.get_list('local_id')}. We have received encouraging news from the local project: After many years of support from the local church staff and you as a sponsor, ${name} is now reaching the end of the sponsorship program and ${child.get('is')} thriving on ${child.get('his')} own as a young adult.
% if one: The local staff has reported to us that ${name}'s current goals are: ${lifecycle.get_list('future_hope_ids.value')}. Due to your commitment to ${name}, much of ${child.get('his')} achievements can be attributed to your generosity.
% else:
% for one_child in child: % set lifecycle = one_child.mapped('lifecycle_ids') and one_child.mapped('lifecycle_ids')[0]
${one_child.preferred_name}'s current goals are: ${lifecycle.get_list('future_hope_ids.value')}. % endfor
% endif Thanks to your regular support, ${name} ${child.get('was')} able to attend school, receive clothing, medical treatment, and balanced, nutritious meals. ${child.get('he').title()} ${child.get('was')} also able to participate in activities that have helped ${child.get('him')} in ${child.get('his')} development both socially and spiritually. We are convinced that these seeds you have sown will bear fruit in ${child.get('his')} life. In addition, ${child.get('his')} family ${child.get('has')} also benefited from the support of your sponsorship. They have been encouraged and have also participated in various activities and trainings organized by the project.
% if object.partner_id in sponsorships.mapped('correspondent_id'): Please feel free to send a farewell letter to ${name} to encourage ${child.get('him')} as ${child.get('he')} ${'enters' if one else 'enter'} the next chapter in ${child.get('his')} life.
% if sub: % if one: As you already know, the plight of children living in poverty is enormous. For instance, ${sub.preferred_name} in ${sub.project_id.country_id.name} is one of them. Would you consider and be ready to sponsor ${sub.get('him')}? We would like to send you information about ${sub.preferred_name} within 15 days to begin a new sponsorship. However, if you would like to support a child from another country, have questions, concerns, or would no longer like to be a sponsor, please do not hesitate to contact us. We can be reached by phone at 031 552 21 25 or by e-mail at: ${object.user_id.company_id.email} % else: As you already know, the plight of children living in poverty is enormous. For instance, ${sub[0].preferred_name} in ${sub[0].project_id.country_id.name} is one of them. Would you consider and be ready to sponsor ${sub.get('him')}? We would like to send you information about ${sub[0].preferred_name} and other children in need within 15 days to begin new sponsorships. However, if you have questions, concerns, or would no longer like to be a sponsor, please do not hesitate to contact us. We can be reached by phone at 031 552 21 25 or by e-mail at: ${object.user_id.company_id.email} % endif % else: We acknowledge that you don't want to take another sponsorship. If you established a permanent order for the sponsorship payment, don't forget to cancel it. % endif
We are grateful to work with you and all our sponsors to help free more and more children from extreme poverty every day.
Best regards,
